title: Không, cảm ơn
summary: A polite refusal for vendors, offers, and small service choices.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Không, cảm ơn is the clean travel phrase for refusing without sounding abrupt. It is useful with vendors, extra bags, taxi offers, refills, menu suggestions, and anything you do not want but want to decline kindly.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Say Không, cảm ơn when the answer is no but you want the interaction to stay friendly.

sections.title: Nearby refusals
sections.body: Use these when the refusal needs more context.

phrases.vietnamese: Không, cảm ơn, có thể để sau
phrases.pronunciation: Khong cam on co the de sau

phrases.vietnamese: Không, cảm ơn, tôi không quan tâm
phrases.english: No thank you, I’m not interested
phrases.pronunciation: Khong cam on toi khong quan tam

phrases.vietnamese: Không, cảm ơn, tôi sẽ xem xét xung quanh trước
phrases.english: No thank you, I’ll look around first
phrases.pronunciation: Khong cam on toi se xem xet xung quanh truoc

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it when declining a product, a ride, a refill, a table offer, a menu suggestion, or a street approach. Say it once clearly and keep moving if the moment is brief.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: The phrase is polite because it combines a clear no with gratitude. You do not need to explain unless the situation truly needs a reason.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: These help after a refusal or a simple polite exchange.
